findings.title: '(i) Support' is called sufficient on its own to fail the control, but the diagnosis's own numbers do not show that
findings.detail: §2.2 H-D says there are 'two separate shortfalls, each enough to fail the control'. The very next bullet admits that 'even an exhaustive search of the support could only pass narrowly by this route'. The +1.8 % L1 figure comes from one hand-built attached-form variant (PHASE outer edge at 45.5 mm, 1.0182 L1(W)). Across the 32 L2 solves, L2/L1 runs from 1.228 to 1.290; the twin's ratio is 1.244. At the low end of that range the variant's L2/L_W would be 1.018×1.228/1.244 ≈ 1.005, which is under the 1.0172 pass limit. So the support restriction alone has not been shown to fail F1(b). The demonstrated cause is (ii), too little prior mass in the lower tail, together with the 20,000-draw budget. The phrase 'so the planted-headroom control cannot be passed' in §4 is too strong for the same reason. The failure class (experimental) and the recommended actions do not change.
findings.evidence: attached_twin re-run: L1/L1W = 0.99781 (u1=47), 1.01820 (u1=45.5), 1.05614 (u1=44). L2/L1 range recomputed: main 1.2284–1.2905, control 1.2420–1.2836, twin 1.2437. Pass needs L_cb/L_W ≤ 1.01720.
findings.suggested_check: Run l2_layout on the 45.5 mm attached variant, or reword (i) as 'narrows the margin' rather than 'sufficient'.

findings.title: '13 of 36 coordinates outside the drawn range' is attributed to the 40,000 run candidates but comes from the 200-draw diagnostic sample
findings.detail: §2.2 Test 2 says, labelled [fact], that across the 40,000 DRC-valid run candidates W lies outside the drawn range in 13 of 36 geometric coordinates. I recomputed the ranges from both streams' stream.json.gz (40,000 unique fingerprints, one topology). The count is 11, not 13: slot1_u0 and slot3_u0 fall inside the run's range. The number 13 matches sampler_support.json's drc_valid block, which holds only n=200 draws from the diagnostic seed. The quoted examples (slot0_u0 [12, 19.5]; slot1_u1 and slot3_u1 [37, 41]) and the 83 mm nearest-candidate distance (83.25) are right for the 40,000. The argument is unaffected.
findings.evidence: Recomputed over 40,000: outside = col_DC+_v1, col_PHASE_v0, col_PHASE_u1, col_PHASE_v1, slot0_u0, slot1_u0 (W 7 vs [7.5, 26.5]), slot1_u1, slot2_u0, slot3_u1, row_LS_u0, land_LS → 11. Minimum Manhattan distance 83.25 mm; D to W 44.0 mm.
findings.suggested_check: Correct the count to 11 for the run pool, or attribute 13 to the 200-draw sample.

findings.title: Code reading of _sample confirmed: slots always start at the column's attached edge, and the PHASE outer edge is capped at pad u1 + 1.5
findings.detail: In derivative._sample a slot is (edge, v0, end, v1) or (end, v0, edge, v1), with edge being the column's attached edge, so a slot can never straddle its column. Widening (+0 to 6 mm) applies to c1 only when side<0. For PHASE, the pad centre is at 42.5 and the housing centre at 27.5, so near=+1, and in the W-like orientation c1 ≤ g_up(44) + 1.5 = 45.5 mm. The flipped side (15 %) attaches the slots on the opposite side, which is not W-like. This supports the §2.2/§4 statements.
findings.evidence: PHASE pad u0v0u1v1 = [41, 31, 44, 34] mm; allowed u range 7–48 mm; derivative.py lines 853–867 and 941–942.

Checked O003 failure_modes F1: response 'experimental failure (INVALID) when (b) … fails', matching the stated failure class. The E010 spec expected_outcome predicted INCONCLUSIVE via +inf GCI and an unlevelled K1, and the gen2_0 rehearsal value was h_ctrl 0.6835 ≥ h_plant 0.4112 − w_ctrl, both as §2.3 states.
caveats: The diagnosis's own scripts (research/diagnoses/T0349/*.py and *.json) are not in this review checkout. I rebuilt the key computations from the diff and from my own code and ran them against the committed run directory, but I did not run the author's files byte-for-byte.

The support argument (i) is shown only at L1, for one hand-built attached-form variant. It narrows the margin but is not shown to be sufficient on its own; the established root cause is the thin prior tail combined with the fixed 20,000-draw budget, under a sampler that cannot express W.

I did not recompute w_ctrl through mfos.metrics.ratio_band_estimate, because a guard hook blocks that import for agents. A rough check of the band ratios is consistent with 2 e_R ≈ 1.3 %, and the F1(b) deficit is 4.4 times w_ctrl, so this cannot change the result.

Remaining uncertainties the diagnosis itself acknowledges: H-C (L1 misranking outside the 32 L2-solved candidates) and a shared L1/L2 bias (H-B residual) were not tested with an external solver or more L2 solves.
Budget figures in §5 are a snapshot: state.yaml now shows $256.37 spent against the $264.99 override, versus the $252.88 quoted.
